title: atip/1 error object
description: The `error` member of a failure envelope (spec section 7). Optional members are omitted when absent, never null. Closed for tools of the current minor; callers read it open (spec 15.8).

hint.description: Exactly one of: a runnable invocation, a command template with <UPPER_CASE> placeholders, or one sentence (spec 7.1.2). A hint that starts with the tool name splits like meta.next[].command.

field.description: The argv name (`--round`, `CHANGE_ID`, `command`) or an RFC 6901 JSON pointer into the --input document (`/round`, `/2/round`).

expected.description: The valid set, when there is one.

received.description: What was given, redacted when it may hold a secret. Never null.

details.description: Only when one input yields several errors; each item is one of them.

code.description: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, registered in the tool's error registry.

reason.description: Which of the situations registered under the error's code this is; registered in that code's registry entry (spec 7.6).
